notes.title: Release date update
notes.content:
Hi folks,

First off, a big thank you to everyone who has wishlisted or played the My Train World demo. We’re grateful for your time and for giving the game a try.

This week we made the decision to postpone our launch to 2021. Originally we wanted to hit the end of 2020 as our release window, but personal and professional obligations outside of our small team means it’s best we delay. With more time, we will have the capacity to keep building the best train set game we know we can make!

We are beyond psyched to keep making progress. We will be adding more trains, new set pieces, make visual improvements, and implement other content that will eventually end up in your hands. As for when in 2021 we’ll launch, we haven’t established that just yet, but we’ll make sure to provide updates once we have a clearer picture.

In the meantime, we’d love for you to try out the demo if you haven’t. We’re always eager to hear your feedback, so feel free to drop us a line on our [url=https://twitter.com/DoubleBlit]Twitter [/url] anytime.

Choo choo!

The My Train World team
